subject: Request: temporary assertion to cover post-report period for HorizonWare
messages:
From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@horizonware.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@horizonware.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary assertion covering post-report period

Hi Marissa,

Hope youre well. HorizonWare is progressing through our security review for the integration project and procurement has flagged a timing gap we need to close before our vendor committee meets next week. We have your SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2027-03-31, but our internal policy requires an attestation that there have been no material control changes in the period since that report date up to the contract execution date (were aiming for 2027-09-01).

Could you provide a short temporary assertion (sometimes called a bridge or continuity note) that: 1) confirms Redwood Inferences control environment remains materially consistent since 2027-03-31; and 2) calls out any known exceptions and remediation timelines if there were changes. Wed like wording that our vendor risk team and legal can accept (typically a brief management attestation is fine, but if you have a short auditor-issued bridge thats even better).

Deadline: ideally by 2027-08-26 EOD so our procurement committee can include it in the packet.

Attached is our standard vendor security checklist for your reference (we also accept a short cover note and the SOC report). Please include any supporting artifacts youre comfortable sharing (control owners, dates of last access review, KMS status, and whether audit logs are retained for 12 months).

Thanks in advance — let me know if you prefer a short call to walk through the wording.

Best,
Laura
Laura Simmons
Security & Risk Manager, HorizonWare
Attachments: HorizonVendor_Checklist.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@horizonware.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary assertion covering post-report period

Laura,

Thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. We can provide a short management attestation that summarizes the control posture since 2027-03-31 and lists any known changes. A few quick clarifying questions to ensure the wording aligns with your vendor team:

- Is HorizonWare OK with a management-signed bridge letter (Redwood exec + security lead), or do you require an auditor-signed addendum?
- Confirm the "up to" date you need the attestation to cover (your note mentioned 2027-09-01).
- Any specific procurement language we should echo (e.g., referencing SOC 2 report date and report UUID)?

Looping in Karthik (security) and Neha (compliance) to gather the artifacts you requested: KMS status, last access review, logging retention, and the draft wording. Well aim to deliver a draft by 2027-08-21 and a signed letter by 2027-08-25 if that works. If you need it sooner, we can prioritize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@horizonware.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-20T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary assertion covering post-report period

On Thu, Aug 19, 2027 at 11:03 AM Marissa Cole wrote:
> Laura,
>
> Thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. We can provide a short management attestation that summarizes the control posture since 2027-03-31 and lists any known changes.

Hi Laura,

A quick summary of what we can include in the attestation and the evidence we can share (high level):

- Controls baseline: confirm no material changes to control objectives covered in the 2027-03-31 SOC 2 Type II report.
- Known exceptions: if any minor configuration or procedural changes occurred, well list them with remediation dates; no outstanding material exceptions to report.
- KMS & encryption: KMS in production (SHA-256 keys managed via AWS KMS, rotation policy quarterly).
- Access reviews: most recent org-wide access review completed 2027-06-14; privileged access list attached.
- Logging/retention: audit logs retained for 12 months in immutable storage; retention policies documented.
- Change control: change window and emergency change process are active; emergency changes logged and reviewed.

We can attach the SOC 2 report (redacted) and a one-page attestation signed by our Head of Security and CFO. If HorizonWare prefers auditor wording, we can check with our auditors; that would take an extra 5-7 business days.

Proposed timeline: draft attestation by 2027-08-21, internal signoff 2027-08-24, signed PDF to HorizonWare 2027-08-25.

Attaching: SOC2-TypeII-Report-Redwood-20270331.pdf (redacted), Redwood-Bridge-Letter-DRAFT.docx

-Karthik
Lead Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@horizonware.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@horizonware.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary assertion covering post-report period

Marissa / Karthik / Neha,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft attachments. Procurement confirms a management-signed attestation is acceptable for HorizonWare provided it: (a) references the SOC 2 report date (2027-03-31), (b) explicitly states the attestation covers controls up to 2027-09-01, and (c) lists any exceptions with remediation dates.

The draft wording you provided looks good. Two final asks before we can finalize:

1) Can you provide a signed PDF (signature from Redwood CFO or Head of Security) by 2027-08-25?
2) Please route the finalized PDF via DocuSign using the following template so our legal team can capture signature audit trails: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/XYZ-bridge-redwood-horizonware

Procurement is also sending a PO once the signed attestation is received. Let me know if you need any specific language for the DocuSign envelope. If all aligned, well expect the DocuSign link and the signed attestation by 2027-08-25 EOD.

Best regards,
Laura
Laura Simmons
Security & Risk Manager, HorizonWare
Attachments: none
